args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosed**: The latest deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.
- **Rolled back**: checkout-api rolled back to **v2.3.0** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Service is now healthy with a low error rate (0.2%).
- **Incident opened**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** filed for checkout-api documenting the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that re-deployment of v2.3.1 is blocked until the failure is investigated. On-call has been paged.
